svg.title: Two halves
svg.text: Two satellites over Nairobi, half the network apart
the grid wraps round: right edge meets left, bottom meets top

g.text: N (northbound) and S (southbound): both 682 km from Nairobi
nearest-satellite attachment picks whichever is closer
from N: 6 275 km to Mumbai's satellite, 23 ms
a station attached to N is close to Mumbai
from S: 52 665 km, 178 ms, about half-way round
same city, same distance overhead, wrong half
